decision: User authorized quarantine of all three held groups on 2026-11-04. Their 108 exact source-capture files were removed from this tree after verifying an external preservation archive; original records and Git history are retained. This does not grant rights to historical/private copies.

closedObservations.correction: The captured README explicitly declares Apache-2.0 at lines 495–499. Missing root LICENSE did not establish an unlicensed README. Added canonical Apache text and bound the existing declaration. Individual skill exceptions retain their own scope.

quarantinedHolds.reason: Exact npm license recovered; its scope-of-license clause lists sharing/publication among restricted actions. Owner must decide public-capture disposition. The notice itself does not clear redistribution.
AGPL texts recovered at captured commits; Warp also has an MIT text. Confirm file-level scope and obligations before a benchmark redistribution decision. No blanket MIT classification.
Captured BUSL text includes parameters and an additional-use grant. Owner must assess the proposed redistribution against those exact terms; no generic permissive-license conclusion.
